recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is; no follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-15606 unless a future work-group decision changes Dosage ownership.
issue_request: FHIR-15606 was a Published/Persuasive non-substantive FHIR-core correction asking to fix the owning work group to Pharmacy on Dosage pages, explicitly naming dosage-examples.html and dosage-mappings.html.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites GForge SVN build@13236 on March 1, 2018. Imported git commit 2e098096b4020c83ff1d38e0347452ee5c79c66c has the matching message "TR #15606 updated owning WG on Dosage pages" and changed dosage-examples.html and dosage-mappings.html from CDS ownership macros to Pharmacy ownership macros.
additional_context: Dosage, DosageDetails, DosageSafety, and DosageCondition are active data types in source/fhir.ini, their type pages route through the dosage page family, and the active owner mappings assign them to phx. source/fhir.ini defines phx as Pharmacy. Current dosage.html, dosage-examples.html, dosage-mappings.html, dosage-definitions.html, and dosage-profiles.html all use [%wg phx%]/[%wgt phx%]. Community searches found no directly relevant conflicting Zulip or Confluence evidence.
reconciliation: No source files were changed because the current authoritative source already satisfies both the explicit Jira page targets and the broader 'all Dosage pages' summary.
